scope: Retrospective quantitative check in the ideal three-dimensional absorbing and four-dimensional emitting exteriors. Full signed one-drain brane-only and common-stream controls calibrate two coefficients. Half-strength, mixed streams and separate paired-surface quadratures are reserved for comparison. No physical tow or free-release run.
